roleTitle: Model B Account Director / Group Account Director

job.rawJd:
Company Description

Model B is an independent growth marketing consultancy fueling growth by creating magnetic connections between companies and their customers. We deliver outsized growth through our team's leadership, executing plans with a coordinated mix of internal resources and global talent from our Partner Collective network.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Account Director / Group Account Director. The AD is responsible for managing and growing client relationships, working with internal teams to drive results and meet client goals, leading and developing business-building Success Plans, managing projects, and participating in the new business development process.

Qualifications

Must have a management consultant's mindset, be well-versed in how businesses operate and make money
Account Management experience spanning B2C and B2B clients, ideally globally
Full-funnel marketer, adept across the channel mix
Project Management expertise
Experience in managing five to seven client accounts simultaneously
Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including search, email, social, and content
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills
8 or more years of agency or marketing experience required
U.S. residents only

Compensation

$135,000 salary (max)
Annual company profit sharing
Unlimited PTO
100% of employee insurance paid, dependents at employee cost
401(k)
